description: Executed grounding for the hunyuan3d-mlx-local capability: the frozen three-stage chain (prep -> seeded shape -> PBR texture) is executed for real on the committed fixture image, the produced bytes must reproduce the captured oracle artifacts byte-for-byte, the seeded shape stage must be shown deterministic across invocations, a refusal path must be exercised end-to-end, and the environment the run depended on (interpreter, upstream checkout + patch, weights snapshot) must be measured and pinned.
notes: SPINE: byte reproduction. The gates pin sha256 constants for every artifact
the chain produces — ref_518.png, ref_518_full.png, shape.glb,
white_mesh_remesh.obj, textured.obj, textured.glb, material.mtl,
paint_pbr.png — and re-hash the run's own work-dir copies and evidence
copies against them. A run that did not produce these exact bytes fails;
nothing in this package can make it pass instead.
ORACLE PROVENANCE, stated not hidden: the prep and shape pins are the
committed eval-2 oracle bytes (evidence/hunyuan3d-mlx-local/eval-2/),
captured 09-17 by an executed run that predates this package. Before this
eval.json existed, a fresh probe run of the same frozen scripts on the same
fixture re-produced those bytes byte-for-byte across a one-day gap
(shape.glb f2fb09c6..., white_mesh_remesh.obj 8281e26b..., ref_518.png
ae1b04aa...). The texture pins originate from that same fresh probe run —
the texture-stage artifacts are pinned from bytes captured before this
package's gates were written; where the eval-2 texture bytes differ from
the probe's, that boundary is recorded in the lineage gate's detail and in
the determinism note below, never silently reconciled.
DETERMINISM, claimed only as observed: two executed runs (the 09-17 eval-2
run and the 09-18 probe run) produced byte-identical prep and shape
artifacts under seed 42. The eval's own bearing_product_e2e_repeat case
executes the whole chain a second time inside the same invocation and its
gate requires byte-identical artifacts and identical measurement stdout
against the first case. What this evidence does NOT establish: byte-level
texture determinism across days if the lineage gate reports a boundary —
in that case the texture pins are still exact-byte pins of the captured
run, and the repeat case is the within-invocation determinism receipt.
STDOUT PINNING POLICY, documented refinement of the cap-5 pattern: the
chain's stdout mixes deterministic measurement lines with wall-clock
lines. The gates pin the deterministic lines EXACT (prep's three lines;
shape's image/output/weights lines, the three Hierarchical Volume Decoding
point counts, the generated counts, extents, bounds, watertight and saved
lines; texture's header and cfg lines) and pin the volatile lines by
REGEX PATTERN ONLY (peak-RSS values, 'pipeline ready in X.Xs', the tqdm
fetch line, the [TIMING] lines, texture-synthesis seconds). Counts and
geometry are properties of the seeded run; seconds and gigabytes are
properties of the day. The eval does not pretend otherwise.
REFUSAL IS EXERCISED, NOT ASSUMED: empty_source_refused runs the real
chain on a 0-byte PNG fixture. The gate requires the prep stage to exit 1,
write NOTHING to stdout, name PIL.UnidentifiedImageError on stderr, run no
later stage, and leave no out_files — the refusal shape observed in a
probe before this package existed.
TORCH-FREE IS AN EXECUTED CLAIM: both heavy stages carry an
``assert "torch" not in sys.modules`` that fires only after the MLX
import path completes. The gate verifies the assert lines and the absence
of any 'import torch' in the frozen script bytes, and relies on the
recorded exit_status 0: an assert that had fired would have made the
stage exit nonzero, and this eval records nonzero stages verbatim.
ENVIRONMENT IS ENVIRONMENT: the interpreter (~/venvs/hunyuan3d-mlx), the
upstream hunyuan3d-2.1-mlx checkout and its working-tree scheduler patch,
and the HF weights snapshot are not committed capability bytes. The
adapter measures their identity at run time; the gates pin the expected
values (head 5fe21945b790fbb7fb28c510e89babd7b9feabe6, patch sha256
784a2344..., snapshot 5b1cf9ae1114c0b046d9385fd4f5ac6570df5287) and the
source_identity gate re-derives the patch hash from the fixture bytes and
a live `git diff` rather than trusting the observation. A future run on a
changed environment SHOULD fail these gates — that is the point of pinning
them.
HELPERS REPLICATE, NOT TRUST: the topology/texture-measurement gates
re-measure the produced GLBs through the pinned interpreter and trimesh,
like the measure helper shipped beside the frozen tool (which they
replicate). The helper interpreter is environment; the measured VALUES are
pinned here, and the helper's numbers must agree with the scripts' own
stdout counts.
HISTORICAL LINKAGE IS ADDITIVE: eval-2 and its registry rows stay exactly
as executed and promoted. This eval adds a new run and a new additive
evals[] row with provenance executed. No historical eval is rewritten to
reflect this result, and no contemporaneous control is manufactured: every
pin above was captured from executed runs before this package's gates
were written, and this file records that ordering honestly.
BUDGETS come from the executed envelope, not aspiration: prep < 120s
(observed ~15s), shape < 900s (observed 477.9s and 492.9s), texture <
800s (observed ~404s), peak RSS <= 10 GB. Peak-RSS is load-volatile on
unified memory: observed 7.15-7.26 GB at pin time but 8.33-8.35 GB on
fresh executions under concurrent load, so the envelope carries headroom
over the highest observed run instead of pinning it. All timing budgets
held on fresh execution. The
budget gate parses the peak-RSS and timing lines from the recorded stdout
streams.
WHAT check.js CANNOT DO: it cannot pin its own bytes (its sha is computed,
not declared), it cannot rescue a run whose artifacts differ, and its
helper interpreter is environment. A blocked gate is never a pass; every
gate here is required.
